comments.story: AI Is Designing Radio Chips That Humans Couldn't Even Imagine
comments.why: Lawyer explains his stunt of algorithmically generating all melodies under CC-0.
comments.text: I’m reminded of lawyer Damien Riehl’s (performative) reaction to the Sam Smith infringement decision, back in 2019/2020. He and programmer Noah Rubin algorithmically generated every possible melody (within a certain combinatorial space, in MIDI format as I recall), and purported to release them under CC-0 license [0]. He went on to attract some attention and explain his argument at a regional TEDx event [1]. I seem to recall legal commentators reacting with an eyeroll—apparently judges split much finer hairs than these for a living—but it was a cute stunt. [0] [LINK] [1] [VIDEO] and [LINK]
